Clinical pharmacists suggested discontinuing tacrolimus immediately and monitoring blood drug concentrations daily. Resumption should be made 3 days after the end of the paxlovid treatment course and after checking blood drug concentrations. Afterwards，the blood trough concentration of tacrolimus was stabilized gradually，blood sugar returned to normal，and the patient's nausea and vomiting was gradually improved.

新型冠状病毒感染（COVID-19）对于患有基础疾病的患者会造成严重的健康问题［1-2］ 。奈玛特韦/利托那韦片（Paxlovid，PAX）是全球首个应用于临床的3CL蛋白酶（3CLpro）抑制剂，2022年2月11日，国家药品监督管理局按照药品特别审批程序，附条件批准PAX进口注册，用于治疗成人伴有进展为重症高风险因素的轻至中度新型冠状病毒感染患者，如伴有高龄、慢性肾脏疾病、糖尿病、心血管疾病、慢性肺病等重症高风险因素的患者［3］ 。
